description: What a stored tool result is, shared by workspace-access (Go, workspace.DetectContentType) and agent-runtime (Java, ResultType). Each case maps the text of a result to the Content-Type recorded for it. The first five lines of a result decide everything but JSON, which reads the whole text.

cases.name: JSON list
JSON object with an items list
JSON with leading whitespace and a newline
JSON empty list
JSON cut off
JSON with trailing text
a bare number is not data
empty
only blank lines
kubectl pods table
cases.input:
NAME      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
coredns   1/1     Running   0          5d
etcd      1/1     Running   2          5d

cases.name: kubectl table with a two word title
cases.input:
NAMESPACE   NAME   NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
kube-system   coredns   <none>   <none>

cases.name: kubectl table with CRLF line endings
cases.input:
NAME      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
coredns   1/1     Running   0          5d
etcd      1/1     Running   2          5d

cases.name: a single upper case word is not a table
a lower case header is not a kubectl table

cases.name: only comment lines are not YAML
a comment line then prose is not YAML
a Markdown title over a bullet list is text
a comment line over one scalar mapping is text
a comment line over a mapping that nests is YAML
cases.input:
# rendered
metadata:
  name: a
kind: Pod

cases.name: a non-breaking space before the # is trimmed like any space
